Hey there JBD! Let this particular qmd file serve as a repo for your ideas for this particular course. 

## IDEAS:

- Using Stochastic character mapping to identify markov jumps between states! Maybe you can prune down your NA Flu "with Poultry" tree to 200 taxa and then do a Markov Jump Reward analysis to generate something. Or potentially you can use the BIO 607 tree that you already have ancestral state estimation on and do both a stochasic map and ancestral state estimation. Actually this is probably the best idea. Its a small dataset and it will work you have the result from it already. 


I will also use this quarto doc to make random things for my course. 

```{r}
#' I need a course banner for CANVAS so here you go. 
library(phytools)

data("mammal.tree")

plotTree(tree = ladderize(mammal.tree),type="phylogram",ftype="i",fsize=0.8,arc_height=0.5)

fastBM(tree = mammal.tree,a = 1,sig2 = 1)

contMap(tree = ladderize(mammal.tree),x = fastBM(tree = mammal.tree,a = 1,sig2 = 1),plot=F)->obj


plot(obj,type="arc",arc_height=0.1,fsize=0.8,offset=5,ftype="off",lwd=10,legend=F)


png(filename="/Users/jonathandain/My_Files/My_Code/Phylogenetics_101/Course_Banner_Tree.png",height = 1200,width = 2500,units = "px",res = 300)
plot(obj,type="arc",arc_height=0.1,fsize=0.8,offset=5,ftype="off",lwd=10,legend=F)
plotrix::boxed.labels(x = 1,y=30,labels = "Phylogenetics 101\n with Jonathan Dain",bg = "grey",border = "black",cex=2,ypad=1.4)
dev.off()

```
